## The question

[When I type the following code, the table comes above the question. How can I make it appear below the question?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/218953/when-i-type-the-following-code-the-table-comes-above-the-question-how-can-i-ma), asked by [Sâu](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/63483/s%c3%a2u) on TeX Stack Exchange (2014-12-21; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> ```latex
> \begin{question}
> Calculate the reverberation time of hall of 1500 \si{m^3} volume
> having a seating capacity for 120 persons when \\
> (i) when the hall is empty \\ 
> (ii) with full capacity audience \\
> (iii) audience occupying the cushioned seats with following data:
> \begin{table}
> \begin{tabular}{| c | c | c |}
>   \hline
>   \textbf{Surface} & \textbf{Area (\si{m^2})} & \textbf{Coefficient of
>     absorption (O W U)} \\
>   \hline
>   Plastered walls & 112 & 0.03 \\
>   Wooden floor & 130 & 0.06 \\
>   Plastered ceiling & 170 & 0.04 \\
>   Wooden door & 20 & 0.06 \\
>   \hline
>   Cushioned chairs (Nos.) & 100 & 1.0 \\
>   Audience (Nos.) & 120 & 4.7 \\
>   \hline
> \end{tabular}
> \end{table}
> ```
>
> ![enter image description here][q-1]
>
>
>   [q-1]: xp9HH.png
:::

The `table` environment is for floating tables. If you don't want your tabular material to move, omit it and just use `tabular`.
